title: Old Drift Lodge
summary: Tented riverside luxury inside Zambezi National Park, with game at your deck.
alt: Entrance to a luxury safari lodge at dusk
body: Set on the banks of the Zambezi inside the national park, Old Drift pairs canvas-and-thatch suites with front-row wildlife. Elephants wander past the deck and the river drifts by below.
Rates are typically full-board with game drives and river activities included — true bush luxury minutes from the Falls.

title: Victoria Falls Safari Lodge
summary: The iconic lodge overlooking a floodlit waterhole alive with game.
alt: Safari lodge overlooking a waterhole with elephants
body: Perched above a busy waterhole on the edge of town, this landmark lodge is famous for its sunset deck and the daily parade of elephant, buffalo and antelope that come down to drink.
An easy, comfortable base with the wild always in view.

title: Palm River Hotel
summary: Riverside elegance and a glittering pool, moments from the Falls.
alt: Riverside hotel exterior with pool at dusk
body: A polished riverside retreat on the upper Zambezi, Palm River blends contemporary design with easy access to the river and the Falls.
Sundowner cruises leave right from the hotel jetty.

title: Inkosi Lodge
summary: Classic comfort and a relaxed pool, with easy access to town.
alt: Lodge pool and terrace at dusk
body: A comfortable, well-run lodge close to the heart of Victoria Falls town — handy for restaurants, shops and activity pick-ups.
A smart-value choice for travellers who want to be close to everything.

title: Pioneers Lodge
summary: A tranquil garden retreat for unhurried, restful stays.
body: Tucked into leafy gardens a little away from the bustle, Pioneers is all about calm — wide verandas, birdsong and a pool to slow down beside.
Ideal for guests who want to unwind between adventures.
